app.title: K-POP Role Quiz - Playful 12-Question Test | DopaBrain
app.description: Take a playful 12-question K-POP role quiz and compare your answer scores across seven role labels. For entertainment only; not an official role, personality test, or talent assessment.
app.ogDescription: A just-for-fun K-POP role result based on your 12 answers. Role labels vary and this is not an official or talent assessment.

boundary.intro: Playful entertainment quiz · not an official role, personality test, or talent assessment.
boundary.result: This result describes only the answer pattern in this attempt. It is not an official K-POP role or a personality or talent assessment.
boundary.spectrum: These bars compare only your 12 answers. They are relative scores, not population percentiles.
boundary.tieRule: If labels tie, a deterministic hash of this attempt's answer sequence chooses among only the tied labels. The same answers produce the same result, and the first label is not automatically favored.

about.text1: Each of the 12 answers adds points to seven K-POP-inspired role labels. The result shows the label with the highest total and a relative score spectrum for this attempt.
about.tieRule: If labels tie, a deterministic hash of this attempt's answer sequence chooses among only the tied labels. Repeating the same answers gives the same result, and the first label is not automatically favored.
about.heading2: What this result does not mean
about.text2: Role labels vary across groups and eras. This game does not test singing, dancing, appearance, age, personality, or professional potential. Results are not official member positions and DopaBrain is not affiliated with any artist or agency.
